python3xy.zip is the Python standard library shipped next to python3xy.dll on Windows.
It is generated by scripts/update_python_zip.py from the CPython sources of vcpkg's python3 port,
compiled like python.org's Windows embeddable package (https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/),
and regenerated by .github/workflows/vcpkg-auto-update.yml with every vcpkg bump.
